file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW/clang (LLD, stripped to external PDB), 7 sections, C++ with RTTI
techniques: ntdll_syscall_number_extraction (SSN harvesting from 4C 8B D1 B8 stub)

injection_details.method: VirtualAllocEx (PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE) + WriteProcessMemory + CreateRemoteThread + WaitForSingleObject(5000) + CloseHandle
injection_details.target_process: own process (self-injection) - handle obtained from GetCurrentProcess() at 0x1400015c3
injection_details.target_discovery: no external target enumeration; kernel32.dll base is additionally resolved manually by walking PEB->Ldr->InMemoryOrderModuleList (function 0x1400017a0) matching wide name 'KERNEL32' ('K'/'k' at index0, '3' at index6)
injection_details.payload_source: 0x60 (96) byte encrypted blob embedded in .data at VA 0x14003E000 (file offset 0x3C200), decrypted in place by AES256Provider before injection
injection_details.payload_write: WriteProcessMemory of the decrypted 96-byte buffer into the RWX allocation, then CreateRemoteThread with the allocation as start address
injection_details.syscall_prep: syscall service numbers for NtAllocateVirtualMemory, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtProtectVirtualMemory, NtCreateThreadEx are harvested from ntdll stubs (function 0x140001920) but the actual injection uses the Win32 wrappers

encryption_details.algorithm: Custom 'AES-256' look-alike (class 14AES256Provider : 14CryptoProvider). Real AES S-box (256 bytes at VA 0x14002F150) but no MixColumns/ShiftRows: for each 16-byte block, 14 rounds of b[j] = SBOX[b[j]] ^ key[j % 32] ^ ((round * 0x1B) & 0xFF)  (routine 0x140001c00, vtable slot +0x10). Round constants: 00,1B,36,51,6C,87,A2,BD,D8,F3,0E,29,44,5F; only key bytes 0..15 are ever used because j<16.
encryption_details.key_storage: hardcoded plaintext array in .rdata at VA 0x14002F0F0 (file offset 0x2E4F0), immediately followed by the string 'ntdll.dll'; passed as 4th argument (r9) to the decrypt virtual method

decoded_strings.0x14002f150: AES forward S-box table (63 7c 77 7b f2 6b 6f c5 ...)
decoded_strings.note: Program strings are stored in plaintext; only the 96-byte injected payload blob is encrypted. Reversing the S-box/XOR schedule over the blob yields no ASCII or recognizable shellcode prologue, so the embedded payload appears to be filler/dummy shellcode bytes rather than a functional stage.

anti_analysis: IsDebuggerPresent check (import 0x1400391c0) - aborts execution before any payload work
NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessInformationClass = 7 / ProcessDebugPort) resolved dynamically from ntdll, result compared against -1
NtSetInformationThread(GetCurrentThread(), 0x11 = ThreadHideFromDebugger) to detach thread from debugger events
TLS callback (0x140001490, registered via .CRT$XL, pointer at 0x14002f090) applies ThreadHideFromDebugger on DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH before main executes
Dynamic API resolution (GetModuleHandleA + GetProcAddress on ntdll.dll) so sensitive Nt* APIs never appear in the import table
PEB (gs:[0x60]) Ldr module-list walk to obtain kernel32.dll base without calling GetModuleHandle
ntdll stub integrity/hook check: validates 'mov r10,rcx; mov eax,imm32' (4C 8B D1 B8) prologue and extracts the syscall number, failing (returns 0) if the stub is hooked/patched
symbols stripped to external PDB; SEH/try-catch wrapping of the injection routine
